An ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] '''battlecruiser''' laid adrift in a [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] pocket of the [[Rishi Maze/Legends|Rishi Maze]], a dwarf satellite [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

==History==
The vessel served a faction of Sith and broke up at some point. By the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was considered a relic and was located in a [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] pocket of the [[Rishi Maze/Legends|Rishi Maze]] satellite [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

Still active after centuries, despite most of it having been ripped apart by gravity of the Rishi Maze, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] encountered this [[Starship/Legends|starship]] while making a delivery run to [[Firebase Alpha]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] installation. The crew of this space station were well-acquainted with the derelict and knew to stay clear.

The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]{{'s}} [[Computer/Legends|computer]] could not identify the kilometers-long [[Warship/Legends|warship]] as it approached, but its crew recognized the [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser's]] age. The still-active ship suddenly dispatched drones to attack the ''Falcon''. Boosting too powerful [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] for ships of their size, they seemed poised to destroy the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], until Han smartly destroyed their power source and obliterated all the drones. This act finally put the ship to rest, and the ''Falcon'' continued towards its destination.
